reasons.console-visible: the console tab on screen took it and opened the page
reasons.overlay-open: AmberX opened it full screen in its overlay
reasons.direct-start: AmberX started the browser on the page
reasons.screen-locked-open: the phone is locked; the full-screen notice opens the page as the screen wakes
reasons.tap-to-open: Android held the browser back: AmberX's notification opens the page with one tap
reasons.url-refused: the address is not one of Brett's own https pages
reasons.console-behind: the console tab is connected but not on screen
reasons.console-other-origin: the connected console is not the site the page is on
reasons.asked-elsewhere: the caller asked for another place
reasons.console-only: the caller asked for the console tab only
reasons.overlay-off: Display over other apps is off on the phone
reasons.overlay-not-ready: AmberX's toolbar is not on screen
reasons.background-start-blocked: Android blocks a browser start from the background while Display over other apps is off and AmberX is not in front
reasons.phone-unlocked: the phone is unlocked, so a full-screen notice would only show as a banner
reasons.no-full-screen-intent: AmberX may not use full-screen notices on this phone
reasons.attempt-failed: the route was tried and failed
reasons.nothing-left: every route was skipped or failed
